name: GuardSpine Discovery Prep
description: Composes pre-call handoff sheets for sales discovery calls. Queries outreach.db for prospect data and discovery_tree.json for matching openers, pitch variants, and objection bridges.

outreach_db_path.label: Outreach DB Path
outreach_db_path.help: Absolute path to outreach.db. Defaults to ~/.claude/outreach/outreach.db

discovery_tree_path.label: Discovery Tree Path
discovery_tree_path.help: Absolute path to discovery_tree.json. Defaults to ~/.claude/outreach/discovery_tree.json
